name: Tulsyan NEC Limited
about: Tulsyan NEC Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel products in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Steel Division, Synthetic Division, and Power. The company offers thermo mechanically treated (TMT) bars, billets, ignots, and sponge irons for construction sector; synthetic woven fabrics; and polypropylene woven sacks and flexible intermediate bulk containers, as well as thermal power. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Chennai, India.
